title: How to Teach Large Multimodal Models New Skills
abstract: arXiv:2510.08564v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: How can we teach large multimodal models (LMMs) new skills without erasing prior abilities? We study sequential fine-tuning on five target skills while monitoring general ability on eight held-out benchmarks across three model families. Surprisingly, we find that performance lost on held-out tasks after fine-tuning on one skill can partly recover when the model is subsequently tuned on a different skill. We trace this behavior to a measurable shift in the output token distribution, manifested through a simple counting-bias probe that shows the shift co-varies with forgetting. Guided by this insight, we identify two simple, robust tuning recipes that learn strongly while limiting drift: (i) updating only the self-attention projection layers (SA Proj., $\Delta$ learning +24.9 / $\Delta$ held-out forgetting -0.6), and (ii) updating only the MLP Gate&Up while freezing the Down projection (+30.5 / -2.1). translated_title: 如何教会大型多模态模型学习新技能
translated_abstract: 如何在不擦除已有能力的前提下，教大型多模态模型（LMMs）学习新技能？我们研究了在五个目标技能上的顺序微调，同时监测三个模型家族在八个留出基准上的通用能力。令人惊讶的是，我们发现模型在微调某一项技能后在留出任务上损失的性能，在随后微调另一项不同技能时能够部分恢复。我们将这种行为追溯到输出token分布的可测量偏移，并通过一个简单的计数偏差探针来体现，该探针显示这种偏移与遗忘共同变化。基于这一洞察，我们识别出两种简单而稳健的微调方案，它们在强劲学习的同时限制了漂移：（i）仅更新自注意力投影层（SA Proj.，Δ学习 +24.9 / Δ留出遗忘 -0.6），以及（ii）仅更新MLP的Gate&Up而冻结Down投影（+30.5 / -2.1）。两者都显著优于……
tldr: 该研究发现大型多模态模型在顺序学习新技能时的遗忘与输出token分布偏移共同变化，并提出两种简单微调策略——仅更新自注意力投影层或仅更新MLP的Gate&Up（冻结Down投影），能在强劲学习新技能的同时将通用能力遗忘降至最低。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that forgetting during sequential fine-tuning of large multimodal models co-varies with output token distribution shifts, and proposes two simple tuning recipes—updating only self-attention projection layers or only MLP Gate&Up with Down frozen—that learn new skills strongly while limiting forgetting of prior abilities.
